warning: No Colorado waterfowl closures are drawn. Chapter W-05 sets reservation-only waterfowl hunting on named state wildlife and park properties (hunt zones, time slots, six hunters per zone), and each state wildlife area has its own closed dates and refuge parts; read the property’s page. Federal refuges set their own rules (Refuges layer). Not being listed does NOT make a place open.
source: CPW Commission Chapter W-05 (Small Game - Migratory Birds), #504 and the property pages.
